headline: One design system for every Pace product
subhead: Pace gives product designers and engineers shared components, tokens and guidelines so financial interfaces stay consistent across web and mobile.
note: Free for all Pace Capital teams.
pageSummary: 142 components are published, and 9 of them have changes waiting for accessibility review.

chat.question: Which components still use the old color tokens?
chat.answer: 31 components still reference legacy color tokens, mostly in the Advisor portal. Data table and Date picker account for 18 of those references.
chat.followUp: Do you want me to open migration tickets for them?

code.comment: # Install the Pace tokens package and build platform outputs
code.command: npm install @pace-capital/tokens@4.2.0 && npx pace-tokens build --platforms web,ios,android

sms.text: Hi Dana, the Pace design system v4.2 is live. The updated Data table is ready for you to try in staging.
Thanks. Does it fix the keyboard focus issue on sortable headers?
Yes, focus order and visible focus rings were fixed in 4.2. Release notes are in the Releases tab.
